Dear Sir/Madam
It appears we have not received your monthly Council Tax payment on time and you now owe £XXX.XX.
If you have paid your Council Tax, and there is nothing left to pay for the year, please ignore this
reminder.
If you have not yet paid all your Council Tax, please pay £XXX.XX within the next 7 days using one of the
methods shown over the page. If you do not pay by DD.MM.YYYY, we will send you a court summons and you
will have to pay an additional £75.00 in costs.
If you cannot pay what you owe you need to tell us immediately. Contact us on 01842 756577 so that we can
discuss options with you. You may also want to seek advice from organisations like Citizens Advice or the
Money Advice Service.
If you have any questions about this notice, please contact us using our contact form or call us on the phone
number shown above. Always remember to tell us your account reference when you contact us.

sign up now at or by calling us on 01842 756 567
Any personal information shared with us in regards to your Council Tax bill will be processed, protected
and disposed of in accordance with the UK General Data Protection Regulation and the Data Protection Act
2018. Your Council Tax information may also be shared where we have a legal requirement to do so, for
example bodies responsible for auditing, administering public funds and statistical analysis, or for the
purpose of preventing and detecting fraud. We may also use your data for purposes of electoral
registration but this does not mean you will be automatically registered to vote. For more information
go to:
angliarevenues.gov.uk/eastcambridgeshire
We accept debit and credit card payments 365 days of the year
Go to to pay online any day, any time; or call
0300 456 0692 to pay using our 24 hour automated phone payment line. You will need
your credit/debit card and your Council Tax account reference from the front of this bill.
angliarevenues.gov.uk/eastcambridgeshire
www.eastcambs.gov.uk/notices/privacy-notice
Do it online angliarevenues.gov.uk/eastcambridgeshire
More than 80% of people pay their Council Tax bills by Direct Debit - it's the UK's
favourite way to pay bills
trust Direct Debit to put you in control of your bills
the Direct Debit Guarantee protects you in the rare event that there is an error in
the payment of your Direct Debit
manage your Council Tax account at a time that suits you
help to save trees and reduce carbon
By Post Send cheques to East Cambridgeshire District Council,
The Grange, Nutholt Lane, Ely, Cambs, CB7 4EE. You MUST quote your Council Tax
account reference as shown on the front of this bill on the back of your cheque.
Are you behind with your Council Tax payments?
If you fall behind with your Council Tax payments you may lose the right to pay by
instalments and the Council may ask you to pay all you owe straight away, or even take
you to court. Tell us if you miss a payment. We will try to help you stay in control of your bill.
Help with managing debt is also available at MoneyHelper
To see if you are entitled to Council Tax support, go to
moneyhelper.org.uk/en
Moving home and people moving into or out of your home are likely to affect your Council
Tax bill and you need to tell us as soon as you can at angliarevenues.gov.uk/eccontactus
Council Tax instalments
You can pay your Council Tax in 12 monthly instalments from April to March, instead of 10.
Whichever way you choose to pay you must tell us if you wish to change to 12 monthly
instalments and provide your Council Tax account reference. angliarevenues.gov.uk/contact
Council Tax information
Other ways to pay your Council Tax
Moving home? Change of circumstances? Let us know
Data Protection and Data Sharing
Phone calls are charged local rate from a BT landline. Other operators and mobile phone charges may vary.
If your instalments change we are required to give you 14 days notice. This may mean that
an instalment is missed and subsequent instalments could be effected.
Go paperless. Sign up today to receive your bill electronically
angliarevenues.gov.uk/eastcambridgeshiremake the switch today at
angliarevenues.gov.uk/eastcambridgeshire
set up a Direct Debit and never forget to pay your Council Tax bill again
Online banking payments
If you choose this method to pay you must:
tell your bank to make the payment at least 7 days earlier than the due date
give your Council Tax account reference of XXXXXXXXX as the payment reference
pay East Cambridgeshire District Council, sort code 52-41-19, account number 43136052
